headline: A formal companion to the 2026 counterexamples to Connes rigidity
claimBoundary: The broad rigidity conjecture was disproved in 2026. This repository separates external counterexamples, Lean-checked companion theorems, exact finite computations, and unreviewed prime-uniform proof candidates.

claims.name: The broad ICC property-(T) rigidity conjecture is false
claims.evidence: Counterexamples were announced independently in 2026. They are prior art for this repository, not results established here.

claims.name: Canonical Hopf structure reconstructs the group
claims.evidence: A Lean formalization is present. Promotion requires the complete pinned-toolchain build, not an isolated file check.

claims.name: A nonzero first-two-symmetric rank-three tensor has infinite elementary orbit
claims.evidence: The Lean source contains the rank-three theorem. The public status remains provisional until the complete dependency graph passes.

claims.name: Stable and critical polynomial tensors have infinite elementary orbit
claims.evidence: A written coordinate-block argument covers tensor degree m<r and a symmetric critical case m=r. It is not yet generally formalized or independently reviewed.

claims.name: Divided pth-power cyclicity holds in stable and odd-critical rank
claims.evidence: A fresh-coordinate induction and an odd-characteristic two-source identity are written down. Exact finite certificates support selected instances but do not prove the general statement.

claims.name: Prime and multivariate finite certificates reproduce
claims.evidence: Deterministic Julia and Python programs check the reported bounded instances. These computations are evidence for finite cases only.

claims.name: An untwisted linear cubic retraction works over every characteristic-three field
claims.evidence: Linearity would force lambda^3=lambda for every scalar. General fields require a Frobenius-twisted formulation.

claims.name: Completed prime-uniform property-(T) counterexample families
claims.evidence: The proposed synthesis still depends on unformalized interfaces and specialist review. This repository does not claim a completed new counterexample family.
